title: Use of PuraStat Following Aquablation to Determine if There is Change in Hematuria & Probability of Same Day Discharge
official: PuraStat for Aquablation Day Case (Use of PuraStat Following an Aquablation Procedure)
summary: Randomized, single-blinded investigational study to assess the safety of PuraStat following the Aquablation procedure
conditions: BPH With Symptomatic Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Subject must be undergoing Aquablation
2. Subject is willing to comply with protocol requirements

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Any significant medical condition which, in the attending physician's opinion, may interfere with the patient's optimal procedure
2. Known or suspected systemic or severe infection
3. Patient unable to give consent
